content: Now the ortho fluorine on the central ring, which is the other feature of my leader. Atoms 4 and 7 are para, so both ring CH positions between them are simultaneously ortho to the arylamine and meta to the anilide - the pattern I want - and in the canonical ordering of the new molecule that CH is atom 16. Its hydrogen is implicit, so the bond displaces it. The product is a difluoro analogue at about 263 Da: conjugated anilide N-H, para 5-fluoropyridin-2-ylamino with both donors free, monocyclic azine, two aromatic rings, LogP near 3.1.
